items.q: What do your digital marketing services include?
items.a: Four services from one team: SEO, social media marketing, performance marketing (Google and Meta Ads), and website design and development.

items.q: How do the four services work together?
items.a: A fast website converts visitors, SEO builds steady enquiries, ads bring quick ones and social media builds trust. We plan them together, so each supports the others.

items.q: Do you work with small businesses?
items.a: Yes. If your budget is too small for what you are asking, we will say so and suggest what to do first.

items.q: How soon will I see results?
items.a: Paid ads can bring enquiries in the first week, and SEO is measured in quarters. We read the numbers every month and tell you plainly what is working.
A plain-language monthly report from your own Search Console, GA4 and ad accounts: what we did, what changed and the plan for next month.
Send an enquiry or call +91 84619 58162. After a first conversation we send a written plan with scope, stages and price.

items.q: Is the ad budget included in your fee?
items.a: No. Ad spend goes to Google and Meta directly and is separate from our fee.
